checkpoint: corner grips, stable preview targets and corrected keyboard reordering
source_digest_scope: Sorted relative file names + NUL + bytes + NUL: src, benches, examples, tests, assets, tools excluding pycache; Cargo/build/toolchain/format/lint/Make/launcher files. Portable Cargo.lock bytes.

environment.build: release, thin LTO, one codegen unit
environment.cargo_sources: 41 temporary upstream source substitutions; unchanged 266-package version/dependency graph; portable registry lock restored afterward
environment.renderer: Ratatui TestBackend; separate optimized actual SGR/CSI PTY smoke
environment.control: Three fresh processes per size; shared-host scheduling and caches uncontrolled

correctness: Each operation checks saved dimensions, exact readable/clipboard bytes or annotation source order and destination. New grip/keyboard roundtrips check their independent intermediate and final orders. Initial syntax completion, fixture creation and drag event allocation/cloning are outside operation timers.

workloads.grip: 40 roundtrips; each has two persisted moves, 128 motion events and four preview/commit frames
workloads.keyboard: 200 roundtrips, with two persisted Alt-arrow moves and frames

limitations: No speedup claim: the grip/keyboard workloads are new.
Reordering was added before selection/note workloads; the earlier pane record is historical, not a controlled before/after comparison.
Timers measure dispatch, real reflow/poll and TestBackend frames, excluding physical terminal paint and input transport.
Whole-process RSS/wall include setup. RSS is not an allocation count.
Physical Alacritty and clean-registry/advisory qualification remain unavailable.
